apps.intro: “Don’t Capture” keeps the app’s copies out of history; “Block Shortcut” ignores the global shortcut while the app is frontmost; both can apply together. Unrestricted by default, with password managers set to Don’t Capture.

capture.hint: Uses the first available representation from the top down

data.backupHint: Export history, resources and settings to an .ecopastebak file, or import a previous backup.

dataDir.changeBody: History, settings and resources are copied to the selected folder, then EcoPaste restarts. The previous folder is kept.
dataDir.restoreBody: History, settings and resources are copied back to the default folder, then EcoPaste restarts. The current default folder is kept as a backup.

deletion.intro: Confirmation switches apply to their own item type; with “Allow Deletion” off, that type has no delete action.
